name: Kamisama no Hitsugi
source:
One day, the earth is destroyed by the impact of a meteorite and the normal life of Chibana Michiru comes to an end.

He wakes up to a strange voice calling him, in front of him stands a classmate he has never spoken to before. He knows that they are inside the ”mysterious room”.

This is a forgotten memory, a story that makes him remember little by little.

Sad and cruel.
Beautiful and painful.
The worst love story.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ259167.html]DLsite English[/url]]
